mapper.sql: pkr.id,pkr.patient_id patientId,pkr.linked_patient_id linkedPatientId,pbi.name relationName,pkr.kinship_id kinshipId, pbi.gender gender,pbi.mobile mobile,pkr.remarks,pkr.crt_time crtTime,pkr.inservice, pkr.type
mapper.select: select from patient_kin_relation pkr join patient_base_info pbi on pkr.linked_patient_id = pbi.id where pkr.patient_id = #{id} and pkr.type = #{type} order by crtTime desc

select pkr.id id,pkr.org_id orgId,pkr.patient_id patientId,pkr.linked_patient_id linkedPatientId,pkr.kinship_id kinshipId,pkr.remarks remarks,pkr.inservice inservice, pkr.crt_id crtId,pkr.crt_name crtName,pkr.crt_time crtTime,pkr.upt_id uptId,pkr.upd_name updName,pkr.upd_time updTime from patient_kin_relation pkr where inservice = 1 and pkr.type = #{patientKinRelation.type} and pkr.patient_id =#{patientKinRelation.patientId} and pkr.linked_patient_id =#{patientKinRelation.linkedPatientId}
select from patient_kin_relation pkr join patient_base_info pbi on pkr.patient_id = pbi.id where pkr.linked_patient_id = #{id} and pkr.type = #{type} order by crtTime desc
